### Well Done, David Schumm
Author: David C. McCasland
Site: Our Daily Bread
URL: https://military.odb.org/well-done-david-schumm/
Passage: Isaiah 35:4
Points:
- David Schumm served others with joy and perseverance despite living with severe cerebral palsy.
- He anchored his faith in Isaiah's promise that God will come to save and heal his people.
- The prophecy assured ancient captives, and all who follow God, of future deliverance.
- Hope in Christ's return sustains believers through hardship and inspires constant gratitude.

### The Glory of the Restoration
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/glory-restoration
Passage: Isaiah 35:5-6
Points:
- God offers promises of future renewal even while warning his people about judgment and exile.
- Isaiah encouraged weary, depressed believers by assuring them that God had not abandoned them.
- Healing the blind, deaf, and lame pictures deep spiritual renewal as well as physical restoration.
- Jesus' healing ministry confirmed him as Messiah and inaugurated the recreation of all things.
- Believers share in this redemptive renewal through personal faith and union with Christ.
